public_safe_invariants: pre-launch consequential mutation, promotion, deployment and publication require current root-authority approval
root authority may halt, reject, revoke, rollback or require re-proof
authority approval cannot manufacture evidence, change measured physical state, or convert an unverified claim into VERIFIED
distributed components do not imply distributed constitutional authority
authority transition requires explicit launch/decentralisation gates, empirical readback and a promoted governance state
missing or unreadable internal authority contract holds consequential action
release_rule: Do not project the detailed authority topology, credentials, override mechanics, internal rationale, or named internal role mapping to public surfaces.
public_projection: owner-governed pre-launch validation with staged transition to distributed governance after verified launch gates
raphael_boundary: Raphael internal hypotheses/models remain internal by release class and evidence state; public Raphael output is separately approved projection only.
